cases.text:
The portions are already incredibly small.
But I can't remember how many times I've failed to enjoy my meal here. The drinks are excellent. The food is completely tasteless. The coffee and drinks arrived early, and we waited for the food. The coffee got cold while it was still being served. Very disappointed.

A beautiful place with terrible food and tasteless coffee. The staff doesn't speak English, and even with a Vietnamese translator, it's difficult to understand. Some menu items are out of stock, even though I was there in the morning. If you need to work, it's probably a good place, but if you want a decent meal, it's definitely not worth coming here.

I was really excited to try this place however it didn’t live up to its expectations for me. Perhaps because I dined in the evening rather than brunch. I was literally the only customer and it took them 45 minutes to serve a burger and fries that were cold. The bun was really tuff and rubbery meat was overcooked. When I told the server my fries was cold he puts his hands on my French to check the temperature and said no it’s not and hands it back to me. I asked if I could have Warner fries waited for another 15 minutes for piping hot fries that were half cooked and very soggy not crispy. I couldn’t enjoy the meal or atmosphere as the staff seemed a bit young and immature, laughing, giggling and just not very professional for a burger that cost 258 vnd. I was offered a drink but at that point id lost my appetite. Maybe the staff was having a difficult time or thought they could get a way with how they treated me since I was the only customer, but the service was purely unacceptable and I certainly won’t visit again.

We ordered the Vitamin C and fresh orange juice, but both drinks were nearly tasteless - like water with just a hint of juice. We placed a to-go order for three drinks, it took quite a while to prepare, and they only gave us two. We had to reorder the missing one separately. We were charged more than the menu price
- twice. It seems they intentionally added the service fee for takeaway drinks two times. Disappointing experience overall, but nice atmosphere.
Bot expensive, but really nice food.

Maybe I chose the wrong menu item, but I expected more from the 200,000 dong fried eggs. Firstly, it didn't look like the picture—the meat and potatoes were separate, and the coleslaw was separate. Secondly, the meat was streaky, so it was practically impossible to chew. The potatoes were just ordinary deep-fried potatoes, and instead of the promised cucumbers and lettuce, they served shredded cabbage with microgreens. The place itself was beautiful and busy, but I was unlucky.

I visited because the reviews said the brunch was delicious, but contrary to the reviews, the taste was terrible.

The beef at “Bo ne” was poorly prepared, and there were too many tough parts throughout the meal, making it uncomfortable to eat. The price is unreasonable considering the quality of the food.

I don't understand why the reviews are good enough to warrant traveling all the way from downtown Nha Trang just to come here. I do not recommend it.
